propositions: Five experiment artifacts cited in merged code changes (criteria_routing.json, design docs) were never committed to the repo, leaving dangling citation references and broken provenance trail.
docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py is cited in three comment fields of criteria_routing.json but does not exist on origin/main.

The calibration report, escaped-bug analysis, and parity-oracle prototype files exist only as untracked working-tree state and must be committed verbatim to restore the evidentiary basis for prior ticket deliverables.

Existing files in docs/experiments/ (e.g., calibrate_plan_review_thresholds.py, derive_code_review_threshold.py) establish the directory as the canonical home for investigation artifacts; the landing is inert at runtime and outside lint/package scope.
All five artifacts have been written and are ready for verbatim commit; no code changes or behavior modifications are required.
